description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the Activated Parameters Ratio (%) and the Eval PPL (perplexity) for different configurations of a Mixture of Hidden-Dimensions Transformer (MoHD). The x-axis, labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio(%)", is a linear scale ranging from 25% to 100%, with tick labels at 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100%. The y-axis, labeled "Eval PPL.", is also a linear scale, with tick labels at 11.5, 12, 13, 13.5, and 14. The plot includes three lines representing different configurations: "Only MoHD FNN" is depicted with a dashed line and square markers, "Only MoHD ATTN" with a solid line and circle markers, and "MoHD ATTN + MLP" with a solid line and cross markers. The "Only MoHD FNN" line remains relatively flat across the x-axis, indicating a stable Eval PPL. The "Only MoHD ATTN" line shows a slight increase in Eval PPL as the Activated Parameters Ratio decreases. The "MoHD ATTN + MLP" line exhibits a significant increase in Eval PPL as the Activated Parameters Ratio decreases, with the highest Eval PPL value at the 25% Activated Parameters Ratio.
